map.由磁场求相邻能级分裂 使用指南: Adjacent Energy-Level Splitting from Magnetic Field — User Guide
map.输入磁感应强度 B，工具按 ΔE=μ_B·B 计算相邻塞曼子能级的能量差，说明外: Enter magnetic flux density B; the tool computes the energy gap between adjacent Zeeman sublevels by ΔE=μ_B·B, showing that an external field splits levels equally—used for the Zeeman effect in atomic spectra and spectral calibration of field strength.
map.输入磁感应强度 B，求相邻塞曼能级能量差。: Enter B to find the energy gap between adjacent Zeeman levels.
map.磁场中能级裂距。: Level splitting in a magnetic field.
map.由主量子数求角动量: Angular momentum from principal quantum number
map.由能级差与温度求粒子数之比: Particle-number ratio from level gap and temperature
map.正常塞曼用轨道磁矩；含自旋（g=2）为反常塞曼，裂距更复杂。: Normal Zeeman uses orbital magnetic moment; with spin (g=2) it is anomalous Zeeman, with more complex splitting.
map.ΔE=μ_B·B，裂距随磁场线性增大。: ΔE=μ_B·B, so the splitting grows linearly with the field.
